description: Average positive-word polarity is at least the minimum positive-word polarity.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of positive-word polarity values cannot be below their minimum.

description: Maximum positive-word polarity is at least the average positive-word polarity.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of positive-word polarity values cannot exceed their maximum.

description: Average signed negative-word polarity is at least its minimum polarity.
explanation: For signed values, the arithmetic mean cannot be below the most negative observed value.

description: Maximum signed negative-word polarity is at least its average polarity.
explanation: For signed values, the arithmetic mean cannot exceed the largest, least-negative observed value.

description: Total hyperlinks cover at least the number of self-referential hyperlinks.
explanation: Self-references are a subset of all article hyperlinks.

description: The average historical shares for the worst-performing keyword are at least its minimum historical shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of the historical share values for a keyword cannot be below their minimum.

description: The maximum historical shares for the worst-performing keyword are at least its average historical shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean cannot exceed the maximum of the historical share values for that keyword.

description: The average historical shares for the middle-performing keyword are at least its minimum historical shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of the historical share values for a keyword cannot be below their minimum.

description: The maximum historical shares for the middle-performing keyword are at least its average historical shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean cannot exceed the maximum of the historical share values for that keyword.

description: The average historical shares for the best-performing keyword are at least its minimum historical shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of the historical share values for a keyword cannot be below their minimum.

description: The maximum historical shares for the best-performing keyword are at least its average historical shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean cannot exceed the maximum of the historical share values for that keyword.

description: The average historical shares for the worst-performing keyword do not exceed those for the middle-performing keyword.
explanation: Keywords are ranked by their historical average shares, so the worst-ranked keyword has no greater average than the middle-ranked keyword.

description: The average historical shares for the middle-performing keyword do not exceed those for the best-performing keyword.
explanation: Keywords are ranked by their historical average shares, so the middle-ranked keyword has no greater average than the best-ranked keyword.

description: The average shares of linked earlier Mashable articles are at least their minimum shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of linked-article share counts cannot be below the minimum linked-article share count.

description: The maximum shares of linked earlier Mashable articles are at least their average shares.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of linked-article share counts cannot exceed the maximum linked-article share count.

description: Maximum positive-word polarity is at least minimum positive-word polarity.
explanation: The maximum of a set of positive-word polarity values cannot be below its minimum.

description: Maximum signed negative-word polarity is at least minimum signed negative-word polarity.
explanation: The maximum of a set of signed negative-word polarity values cannot be below its minimum.
